title: Open the curved master grid's sparse end so fillDensity 1..50 changes the picture (F-01)
notes: M1/M2 FOLLOW-UP (finalizing the c861bf97 WIP checkpoint left by the prior agent). M1 bar: torus x hatch x ladder must not tie at Density 1 vs 25 and must be monotone at the audit's literal checkpoints 1/10/25/50. Root cause of the WIP's own first attempt (CURVED_SPARSE_PITCH_BOOST=6, landed in 16c197d7): widening the pitch curve opens the master-grid ruling count N monotonically, but the ladder's per-band coverage rounding is NOT monotone in N -- widening only relocates which Density checkpoint lands on an unlucky ruling count. At 1/10/25/50 specifically, boost=6 reintroduced the literal F-01 symptom: torus+hatch+ladder [4,3,4,10] (d=10 dips below d=1, d=25 TIES d=1) and sphere+hatch+ladder [5,4,9,23] (d=10 dips below d=1). c861bf97 re-swept CURVED_SPARSE_PITCH_BOOST against sphere/torus/cone x hatch x {ladder,fineLadder} simultaneously and landed on 4.1: path count is now non-decreasing AND total ink is strictly increasing across 1/10/25/50 on all six combos. torus+hatch+ladder (the M1-named tie) is now [3,5,7,10] -- d=1=3 != d=25=7, strictly increasing, tie resolved. Verified against the REAL rendered app (not just SF.buildObject path counts): captured sphere/torus x hatch x ladder x low/med/(max for torus) from the worktree via scene3d-capture.js into after/W-01-M1/ and diffed md5 against the pre-fix gallery images in shots/A/ -- med (d=50) and max (d=220) are BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-fix images (sphere med 14b9a50d..., torus med 81058536..., torus max 29eb6995... all unchanged), while low (d=1) now differs from med on both primitives and LOOKS visibly sparser (sphere: ~3 rulings vs ~13 at med; torus: ~2-3 rings vs ~7-8 at med vs ~30+ at max) -- confirmed by eye, not just by count. One tie survives by design and is documented as acceptable: torus+hatch+fineLadder ties path COUNT at d=10/25 (6==6, different ruling counts 7 vs 10 coincidentally banding to the same segment count) but ink differs (523.85 vs 648.2mm), so it is not a geometry duplicate. M2 (single-integer non-monotonicity at d=8/d=10 etc, off the four named checkpoints) remains OPEN as a follow-up per STILL-OPEN.md -- out of scope for this M1 finalize.
